audits.text:
## e96f42608654

**A2 — Reproduced input-domain defect with a semantic shortcut.** The selected generator requires all motif cells to form exactly one 4-connected component, although canonical training pair index 2 contains two components. Its `self_check` rejects that authoritative input with `motif is split into 2 connected components`. The canonical rule crops all nonzero cells other than the marker, irrespective of their connectivity. Restricting generation to connected motifs therefore admits the incorrect rival “crop the largest connected component, then frame it”: that rival agrees on every validator-accepted input, yet fails on the canonical witness.

Source identity: selected generator SHA-256 `b6eb68ce505337090bec68f968d58b3e0188abfa7e0f6ab2c6bf0bb4af588194`; executed/catalog rule hash `0eb8739f9cf3`; exact rule-text SHA-256 `5d757b20b7618ec48f0a1cdd925de5b6b891d021ebc95a70d076d43b120323f3`. Findings only: no audit generator, rule, helper, or shared source was edited.

The witness is the task's canonical training pair at zero-based index 2 (seed/index/overrides: not applicable). It is a valid task input by direct canonical provenance; it is outside the selected generator's unnecessarily restricted connected-motif domain. The two nonmarker components contain 3 and 4 cells. Both Racket applications completed successfully with `valid_output: true` and matching executed/catalog rule hashes.

| Witness | Validator result | Actual Racket output, rows separated by `/` | Largest-component rival |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Canonical training index 2 | Rejected: 2 components | `333333/378003/370883/307803/333333` | `33333/30883/37803/33333` |
| Generated seed 0, sample index 0 | Accepted: `[]` | `66666/61006/61006/62926/66666` | Same as actual Racket output |

The generated control uses `{"grid_h":6,"grid_w":6,"motif_h":3,"motif_w":3}`. The universal shortcut claim is a consequence of the actual validator and generator construction: with exactly one component, its bbox is necessarily the bbox of all nonmarker cells. It is not an extrapolation from one passing sampled case. The control confirms that the executable rival and Racket application agree on a generated accepted input.

**A2b — Reproduced declared-override defect.** `AXES` advertises `grid_h` and `grid_w` with valid values `6..20`, but `generate` derives both dimensions entirely from padding and motif dimensions without consuming either override. With seed 0/sample index 0 and motif dimensions 3×3, requests for a 6×6 grid and a 20×20 grid return byte-for-byte identical 10×9 inputs. Both pass `self_check`. This is an override contract failure, separate from the connectivity finding. No output-rule failure is claimed for the generated control.

Evidence: `checks/audit/e96f42608654/counterexample.json` contains exact input grids, generator/rule hashes, seed/index/overrides, validator messages, domain statements, actual Racket outputs, rival outputs, and command records. `input.json` contains the two-grid Racket batch; `racket.json` is the unmodified supported CLI receipt. `probe.py` imports the generator using the public `prepare_runtime` API; `verify.py` checks and combines the results.

Reproduction (all three commands run from `packet_root`; the wrapper's effective working directory is `repo`; all observed exit statuses were 0):

```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 ../checks/audit/e96f42608654/probe.py
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply e96f42608654 --input ../checks/audit/e96f42608654/input.json --out ../checks/audit/e96f42608654/racket.json
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 ../checks/audit/e96f42608654/verify.py
```

Scope: reviewed the selected generator, its notes/workspace README, and the assigned canonical row; reproduced one canonical counterexample, one generated control, and one paired override comparison. No full battery, seed census, or exhaustive override audit was run. Other advertised palette controls appear unused by source inspection, but were not separately reproduced and are not additional findings. Suggested task-local repair: allow disconnected motif cells while preserving the intended global bbox crop, test canonical acceptance, and implement or withdraw the advertised dimension axes.
